name: @pipeworx/mcp-nasa-power

tools.name: point_data
tools.description: Time-series observations for a single coordinate. Temporal granularity controlled by the dates supplied — both must be YYYYMMDD; use daily by default.

community.description: AG (agriculture, default) | RE (renewable energy) | SB (sustainable buildings)

tools.name: climatology
tools.description: Long-term monthly climatology averages for a coordinate.

tools.name: regional_data
tools.description: Bounding-box query — daily or monthly data over a rectangular region. Bbox area max ~10° × 10°.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nasa-power forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nasa-power pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
